{{Top|ga|leg}}
'''The First Organa''' was a commemorated figure of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Their House played important roles in the foundation of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaan]] society and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Castle_Organa.png|thumb|right|300px|"The First Organa" monument with the Organa Palace in the background]]
In [[3643 BBY]], the First Organa was commemorated by the monument at the front of the [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa]] estate on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], below the [[Castle Organa|Organa Palace]]. Smaller figures of "The First Organa" were erected across the estate.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa's]] ancestors were among the first [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]]<ref name="Organa Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref>&mdash;the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was first colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in [[27,500 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> after which House Organa was counted among the founding families and [[Great Houses of Alderaan]].<ref name="TORE" /> [[House Alde]]'s [[Darrus Alde]] led the Great Houses after negotiating peace between the warring [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] and being elected the first [[Monarch of Alderaan|King of Alderaan]] by the newly formed [[Alderaanian Parliament]].<ref name="King's Pass">{{TORcite|type=codex|King's Pass}}</ref>

An [[Unidentified House Organa member|Organa]] drafted the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] as part of the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]]. A representative of Alderaan was among the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the Republic who were later commemorated as monuments along the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]] in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] of the Core World [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which served as the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TORE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> with Alderaan led by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] and [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], the latter thought about the [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] used to celebrate the House of Organa's [[Founding Day]] during a [[Mission to Zigoola|mission]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:First_Organa.png|thumb|right|125px|A statue resembling "The First Organa" monument in ''The Old Republic'']]
"The First Organa" monument appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was later identified in the [[2012]] reference title ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TORE" />
